title: Retry test-suite speedup: keep prior changes, suite under 7 minutes
summary: Retry of job 20261025-190606-eebk, following the user's latest reply: keep the prior approach, including the secrets.rs scan memo and the shorter run_check poll schedule (both allowed, each with a test proving unchanged behavior). The target is the full `cargo test --locked` under 7 minutes on the job's machine, with per-binary before/after times measured the same way and recorded in docs/decisions.md. Audience: the user, who reads docs/decisions.md and later job times.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check suite time under 7 minutes and failing tests still failing.
cargo test, clippy and fmt criteria; tests prove each production change.
Decision numbers are measured or labeled.
Per-binary causes are found and recorded.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The prior attempt's approach (memo + poll schedule, ~405 s run) is reapplied from the base since changes were discarded; the 7-minute target then holds with margin.
The memo is keyed on scanner identity plus text, so a replaced binary is not served stale results, to address the earlier security concern; this is a judgment call.
Before/after timings are measured identically (each binary run alone, both times).

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/decisions.md has a new decision with per-binary before and after times (lifecycle, job_plan, drain, retry, steward), both measured the same way in the job and labeled measured, with the cause found for each, and the total suite time.

The decision records compile 67 s vs run 673 s (brain-measured, 4 cores), lists cargo-nextest 0.9.148 (584 s vs 673 s, about 13%) as rejected, and lists sccache per D79 and a shared target dir as considered; no unmeasured number is claimed.
No test is deleted, ignored, filtered or has assertions weakened; test count is not lower than before. athena.toml, ci.yml and tool pins are unchanged. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

Production changes are limited to the secret-scan memo in crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs and the shorter poll schedule in crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs; each leaves behavior unchanged and has a test proving it (memo returns identical results to uncached scanning; poll schedule still detects completion, failure and timeout).
Run `cargo test --locked`: it passes with every test running, the suite's run time is under 7 minutes on the job's machine, and a failing test still fails the run.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both clean.

out_of_scope: Changing athena.toml, ci.yml or tool pins
departures: Higher cost and time than reference: the work needs timing the full suite repeatedly (about 7-10 minutes per run) and the verifier must run it too.
urgent_reason: Cuts Athena's check time (median ~9.7 min) and producer waiting, reducing wasted time on every job.
